steps.content: [Refugee Camp - Night]

Outside Aurum Secretum Research Institute, Fraser Outskirts
Refugee Camp
Moments Earlier

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Okay, don't rush... don't rush... Just like what I saw at the research institute, wait for all the gunk to settle down first, then slowly add this...
With extreme caution, the girl carefully releases the liquid from her pipette into the test tube. A sudden, sharp hiss pierces the air—faint but electric.

Then, tiny golden particles emerge, peeling away from the rough surface like flecks of sunlight. One by one, they drift downward in a slow, glittering descent. As she watches, the tension in her shoulders eases, and she lets out a long sigh of relief.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Ahh... I knew it! How could I mess up twenty times in a row? This time, for sure—
BOOM—!

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: Sigh... it's just not enough. How can this alone be enough...
The man sighs as he weighs the bag in his hand, containing nothing more than a tiny pinch of fine golden fragments.

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: What's the situation at the pool?

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: Not good. This month, we'll all have to stretch what little we have... And if our supplies are low, they'll just push the price down even more...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Then if we add these in, there won't be any problem, right?

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Guys, look what I got today! This whole huge bag full! Hmm... plus all those Aurum Secretum pieces I took while cleaning at the institute. Let's see... how much was it again...
The girl counts earnestly on her fingers, bending them back and forth, but after a moment, she sighs and gives up.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Well, it's definitely more than what we had! Tomorrow I'll take all this to the institute and trade it for supplies and medicine!
The crowd erupts in joy, voices clamoring, buzzing with anticipation and relief as they discuss the soon-to-arrive resources.

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: Thank you, Thani... We wouldn't have made it this far without you...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Oh, don't say that! I'm nothing special at all! I just... kinda have this little ability that helps sometimes, that's all...

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: Oh Thani... Without you, us old bones would've starved long before the screening officer came. Look at you, working yourself to the bone just to put food in our mouths. Come here, let me fix you up...
The three-armed woman picks up a towel and gently wipes the grime from the girl's face.

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: But... how'd you get so many Aurum Secretum bits today? Normally you only come back with a little pouch...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Ehehe! Guess what? I found this whole trail of Aurum Secretum shards today! Like, every few steps, another huge chunk was just waiting for me!

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: Really?! Since when does luck just come knocking at our door?

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Actually, these Aurum Secretum bits all fell off that Apostle Lady Synex caught! I just followed behind and scooped up all the pieces when nobody was looking!
Thani keeps quiet about the risks of her scavenging expedition, unwilling to burden the others with worry.

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: So it was Lady Synex. I knew she hadn't forgotten about us...

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: I know about that Apostle! Heard it took everything—Lady Hypatia, all those Furorians, even the whole town's Aurum Secretum weapons—plus Synex just to barely take it down!

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: Still... Synex must've done most of the heavy lifting, right? Why else would Lady Hypatia get left out of the victory parade?

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: Oh! That reminds me. Sandra, don't you have some cousin or something in the Furor? What's his name... Taric, was it?
The woman sits motionless at the edge of the crowd, her gaze vacant. Even when called by name, she shows no response.

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: You forgot? She's been walking dead ever since they took her kid to the institute... Tsk, lucky family. Brother getting to mine Aurum Secretum while her kid gets treatment at the institute...

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: Exactly... Heard those Furorians just went right into the institute soon as they got here. Meanwhile, the rest of us? Still waiting our turn for the screening like always...
Thani watches the arguments unfold with quiet contentment. In the refugee camp, having both the energy to speak and the spirit to argue is proof of vitality—a sign that life persists even here.

steps.speaker: Uriel
steps.content: Psst, Thani? Come here, just for a sec.
A man stands in the corner, beckoning with secrecy.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Mm? What's up?

steps.speaker: Uriel
steps.content: Well... that "pool" you mentioned, out by the institute's edge? Doesn't it sometimes cough up Aurum Secretum bits?

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Hey, Uncle Uriel! Didn't I tell you guys to stay away from that place? That's not a normal water pool; it's a sewage pipe! What if you get infected?!

steps.speaker: Uriel
steps.content: C'mon, in times like these, who's got the luxury to be picky? Besides...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Besides...?
He glances around to make sure no one else is watching before leaning in close to Thani.

steps.speaker: Uriel
steps.content: This time it wasn't Aurum Secretum that came out; it was a living, breathing person!
Hella eyes the refugees warily. Their grotesquely deformed limbs, barely concealed by tattered robes, twitch unnaturally in the dim light.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Haha... am I seeing things... why is everyone so...?

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: ...! Don't judge them just because they look a little weird! They... they only ended up like this because they got infected. They're all really nice, I promise!
The girl flinches, as if suddenly aware of her outburst, and swiftly steers the conversation back on course.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Um, hey, don't be scared, okay? This is... Zone III on the outskirts of the research institute. I'm Thani. I-I work at the Fraser Institute, as a janitor.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Um... that place you came out of... it's an Aurum Secretum pipe that's super important to us. How'd you even get in there?
As Thani speaks, she suddenly tilts her head, studying Hella's face. The longer she looks, the more familiar it seems.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: ...Wait, you look... Do I know you from somewhere? That's weird...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm Hella! I'm from... Furor! Just got here yesterday. Maybe you saw me at the research institute? Yeah, that's gotta be it!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The institute's so big... I got all turned around and lost my friends. I kept running and running, and then... I just fell right into this horrible hole!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It was so dark... and gross... and there were m-monsters everywhere! I-I really thought I was gonna die down there... Sob...
Hella does her best to look like a terrified, hungry, and exhausted refugee. For extra authenticity, she even feigns a few sniffles, as if she's caught a cold.
Her acting skills must be improving. Hella clearly sees the pity and sympathy in Thani's eyes.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Don't worry! We're all just folks who ended up at Fraser trying to get by, just like you!

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Come with us to our camp! The institute sends us food and blankets pretty often. You'll get your share too.
With that, Thani turns and strides toward the nearby glow of the tents. Meanwhile, the nearby refugees gather around Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: H-hey, what're you— I can walk by myself! Just let me— AAAAAH why are you all putting your hands on me?!

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: You've been sitting in that stinky water for so long. We gotta get you cleaned up first!

After being surrounded by people who clean the grime off her body, Hella is ushered into a tent. The interior is stark—almost barren—with nothing but a threadbare blanket serving as a bed. Yet what unsettles her most isn't the emptiness, but...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: —Why the hell do you have HER picture hanging by the bed?!
And she's totally posing to look all cool! Gross, it's so gross!

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Oh! I forgot to tell you, this tent was actually little Yuri's. He passed the screening last week, so you can stay here now.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: He's a huge fan of Synex, always going, "I wanna be brave and amazing like her!" He even put up that poster to keep himself motivated.
Synex? A role model? Brave? Amazing?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahahaha... Synex... I mean, she's impressive in a way, but "brave and amazing"? None of them fit her at all!

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Well... I haven't really met her much myself, but everyone around here totally admires her.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: You know, she didn't rely on anybody. Just her own smarts and hard work got her into the research institute. And now she's living a good life, and she's the strongest Aurum Secretum Warrior protecting everybody.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: It's only with such an amazing role model that everyone in the camp knows what to work toward.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I guess you have a point... but...

Hella lets out a long sigh, deciding not to argue with Thani. After all, don't bite the hand that feeds you. If she keeps contradicting them, she'll likely end up right back in that stinking ditch she crawled out of.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Okay, fine. Maybe I... didn't have the whole story. Thanks for sharing all this with me. I... I think I understand Synex a bit better now!
Every muscle in Hella's body tenses as she fights back her revulsion, choking out words so false they taste bitter on her tongue.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Hehe... I knew it! Nobody from Furor could ever be bad.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Oh! If you like Synex, Yuri actually hid some more posters here...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No, no, no, no thanks! I've been busting my butt all day and I'm wiped! How about we talk more tomorrow?

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Um... alright... And just so you know, this tent's a bit drafty, so use an extra blanket when you sleep!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Alright, alright, I'll keep that in mind!
The moment Thani steps out, Hella lunges for her bag. Too impatient to rummage through it, she upends the whole thing, sending its contents clattering to the ground.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...It's still here. Thank goodness.
Fraser and Synex have played them all for fools. No more delays—she has to get this intel out, now.
She jabs at the communicator, redialing again and again. A dozen attempts later, all she gets is the same infuriating static.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Damn it... How is this happening...
The static crackles once again. Completely frustrated, Hella hurls the device to the ground.
It bounces a few times before skidding to a stop near the tent entrance.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Ugh, that was a gift from my friend! What am I even thinking...
Letting out another sigh, Hella bends down to pick up the communicator, but as she does, her gaze flickers up through the gap in the flap. And there, in the darkness, an eerie face looms—

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: ...Still awake?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Eeeek—A ghost—!

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Um... sorry... I heard some rustling and got worried something was wrong, but I didn't mean to...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm fine.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: That's not fine at all! Look how big this bump is on your head!
Hella has no comeback and can only turn her head away.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: I'm really sorry! Um... maybe I can do something to help? I'll do anything!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Unless...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Unless?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Ahem, you know some DisCity people came with us yesterday, right? Do you know where they are?

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: The DisCity people? Hmm... I know they're staying in the northwest part of Zone II. It's the most out-of-the-way spot.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Most folks around here get all huffy about DisCity people. But personally, I don't think it's a big deal. We're not that different...
Perfect, the fish took the bait. Hella rubs her eyes, her face crumpling as if she's about to burst into tears.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Look, I know most DisCity jerks suck, but this crew actually got us here safe from Furor. And they were pretty nice to us the whole way, so I just want to send them a message to say thank you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I was planning to go myself, but it's so late now... I'm injured all over, and I just hit my head...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: ...!! I know these parts pretty well! Let me go for you!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That's wonderful! You're such an amazing person!
All according to plan. Hella didn't expect her to take the bait so fast... She's even made Thani blush with that flattery.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Aww... hehe... I'm really not that great... Do you need to write a letter or something? Should I get you some paper and a pen?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Nah, just tell them—

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: "Found the thing. Hurry back home and report"!
